clip.en: We had a clip of people scratching and you had to decide what is being scratched.
clip.zh: 我们听了一段人们挠痒的录音，你需要判断被挠的到底是什么。

clip.en: Now, in the clips we’ll hear journalist Asma Khalid asks Fergal Keane about his own experience with childhood trauma.
clip.zh: 现在，在我们听到的片段中，记者阿斯玛·哈id向费尔加·基恩询问了他自己经历童年创伤的经历。

clip.en: Oh, well, that first clip made me feel really relaxed.
clip.zh: 哦，第一段音频让我感觉真的很放松。

clip.en: And if you’ve seen clips of people standing up in an old-looking room with wooden benches with green fabric, shouting at each other, this is what’s happening.
clip.zh: 如果你看过人们站在一个铺着绿色织物木质长椅、看起来很有年代感的房间里互相大喊大叫的片段，这就是正在发生的事情。

clip.en: To show a facade of continuity, Saudi state television broadcast a clip of the newly appointed MBS kneeling to kiss the hand of the deposed heir, MBN.
clip.zh: 为了营造一种权力平稳过渡的表象，沙特国家电视台播出了新任王储MBS下跪亲吻被废黜的继承人MBN手背的片段。

clinical.en: So, why is this? In this episode, we'll hear from a clinical psychologist and research associate at the University of Cambridge talking about screentime and children.
clinical.zh: 那么，这是为什么呢？在本期节目中，我们将听到一位来自剑桥大学的临床心理学家兼研究助理谈论屏幕时间与儿童的话题。

clinical.en: Clean, clinical, calm and unemotional. And as a reminder, the participants, the teachers, had been clearly told that they could leave at any time.
clinical.zh: 干脆、公事公办、冷静而不带情绪。顺带提醒一下，参与实验的“教师”们其实已经被明确告知，他们随时都可以离开。

clinical.en: Now let’s hear Dr Becky Kennedy, a clinical psychologist and founder of an online parenting platform, talking about how parents feel about tech and children, for BBC World Service programme, Tech Life:
clinical.zh: 现在让我们听听Becky Kennedy博士的发言，她是一位临床心理学家兼在线育儿平台的创始人，她在BBC世界服务部节目《Tech Life》中谈到了父母对科技和儿童的感受：

clue.en: But we have some clues about what goes on behind closed doors.
clue.zh: 但我们对闭门幕后发生的事情有一些线索。

clue.en: One of the most interesting clues is the sweet potato.
clue.zh: 其中一个最有趣的线索就是红薯（甘薯）。

clue.en: The more he looked, the more clues seemed to point to the existence of this city he called Z.
clue.zh: 他越是深入寻找，似乎就有越多的线索指向这座他称之为 Z 的城市。

clue.en: Even the word “freelance” in English gives us a clue about the age of the idea of not being tied to one boss or master.
clue.zh: 甚至英语中的“freelance”（自由职业）一词也为我们提供了一个线索，说明不绑定于某个老板或主人的这种观念有多久远。

clue.en: And there are some small clues that it might be a nitrogen- dominated atmosphere, which, again, is another sort of clue that there could be life there.
clue.zh: 并且有一些小线索表明它可能是以氮气为主的大气层，这也是那里可能存在生命的另一种线索。

clinic.en: In Claire's clinic, she masks the disliked foods with something that is liked.
clinic.zh: 在克莱尔的诊所里，她用人们喜欢的食物来掩盖那些不喜欢的食物。

clinic.en: Funding for a transgender medical clinic in India, $20 million to create a Sesame Street show in Iraq, or even the discovery that the US Air Force had been charged $1,300 per reheatable coffee cup by Boeing.
clinic.zh: 为印度的变性人医疗诊所提供资金，斥资 2000 万美元在伊拉克制作《芝麻街》节目，甚至发现美国空军向波音公司购买每个可加热咖啡杯的花费高达 1300 美元。

clinic.en: Here's Dr Vanessa Apea, consultant in sexual health at Barts Hospital in London, explaining more to BBC Radio 4 programme, Inside Health: So they'll delay accessing the clinic, and also seeking treatment, and so then you'll often see people that could have been diagnosed with what's happening much earlier, and could have had earlier intervention, but it's delayed quite significantly.
clinic.zh: 这是伦敦巴茨医院性健康顾问瓦妮莎·阿佩阿博士，在向BBC广播四台的节目《走进健康》做出的进一步解释：所以他们会耽误去诊所的时间，也会延误寻求治疗，所以你经常会看到一些人，他们本可以在更早的时候被诊断出病情，并获得早期的干预，但却被严重延误了。

claim.en: The people who had always farmed that land suddenly had no legal claim to it.
claim.zh: 那些世世代代耕种那片土地的人突然间在法律上失去了对土地的所有权。

claim.en: However, the neighboring country of Comoros continues to claim Mayotte as its territory.
claim.zh: 然而，邻国科摩罗继续宣称马约特是其领土。

claim.en: And if there were more witches out there, as Tituba claimed, no one was safe.
claim.zh: 而且正如蒂图芭所说，如果外面还有更多女巫，那就没有人是安全的了。

claim.en: The Saudi state claimed to have recovered over 100 billion dollars’ worth of assets.
claim.zh: 沙特政府声称已追回价值超过1000亿美元的资产。

claim.en: These were second, often third-hand accounts, and there is little way of verifying these claims.
claim.zh: 这些都是二手，甚至往往是三手的记载，几乎没有办法核实这些说法。

climb.en: I've climbed some mountains, but only very little ones, so it wasn't that challenging.
climb.zh: 我爬过一些山，但都是非常矮的小山，所以并没有那么有挑战性。

climb.en: Strangers embraced, families were reunited and people climbed onto the wall, celebrating together.
climb.zh: 陌生人拥抱，亲人团聚，人们爬上墙头，共同庆祝。

climb.en: They always did. As long as interest rates stayed low, house prices were allowed to keep climbing.
climb.zh: 它们以前总是会涨。只要利率保持低位，房价就会一直攀升。

climb.en: According to a recent biography, as a teenager he showed little ambition or interest in climbing the royal ladder.
climb.zh: 根据最近的一本传记，他在青少年时期几乎没有什么野心，也对攀登王室阶梯不感兴趣。

climb.en: Or perhaps to working the treadmill, which was a large paddle wheel that you climbed continuously for hours at a time.
climb.zh: 或者也许是去踩跑步机，那是一个大型的脚踏轮，你需要连续爬上好几个小时。

cling.en: If an animal species is clinging on, it's holding on to existence with great effort.
cling.zh: 如果某种动物物种正在苦苦支撑（clinging on），它就是在付出巨大努力维持生存。

cling.en: Many of the others are now clinging on in little isolated pockets of good habitat.
cling.zh: 许多其他的蜂现在只能在生态良好的小块孤立栖息地里勉强支撑。

cling.en: But clay soil is made up of much smaller particles that cling together and naturally stop water from escaping.
cling.zh: 但粘土是由更小的颗粒组成的，这些颗粒紧紧粘在一起，自然地阻止水分流失。

cling.en: To cling means to stick or hold tightly onto something.
cling.zh: To cling 的意思是紧紧粘住或抓牢某物。

cling.en: People hung on his every word, and soon he found that people clung to him, believing that this was not just a future leader of the Labour party, but a future British Prime Minister.
cling.zh: 人们对他言听计从，很快他发现人们都追随他，相信他不仅是工党未来的领袖，更是未来的英国首相。

classic.en: The classic example of this is when children say ‘nana’ instead of ‘banana’.
classic.zh: 这方面的经典例子是孩子们说 ‘nana’ 而不是 ‘banana’。

classic.en: The mentor in the group, Amy, describes the recipe for chana masala as a classic.
classic.zh: 群里的导师Amy将鹰嘴豆咖喱的食谱描述为经典之作（classic）。

classic.en: We call something a classic to say that it is well-known and of good quality.
classic.zh: 我们把某物称为经典，是为了说明它广为人知且品质优良。

classic.en: Or what about a classic car? Some people restore old cars by replacing almost every part.
classic.zh: 或者经典汽车呢？有些人通过更换几乎所有零件来修复老式汽车。

classic.en: For example, ants are a classic example of animals working together.
classic.zh: 例如，蚂蚁是动物协同工作的经典例子。

client.en: If that wasn't stressful enough, Mylene's conversations are monitored by AI systems to see how well she fixes her clients' problems.
client.zh: 如果这还不够有压力的话，Mylene的对话还会受到AI系统的监控，以看她解决客户问题的能力如何。

client.en: Andrea, how is rage bait different to clickbait or other online tactics? […] As a marketer, I'm always, you know, coaching my clients and talking to them about using hooks in their marketing, right?
client.zh: 安德里亚，“愤怒诱饵”与“标题党”或其他网络策略有什么不同？……作为一名营销人员，你知道的，我一直在指导我的客户，跟他们谈论在营销中使用“钩子”，对吧？

client.en: Here, she tells BBC World Service programme, 'Tech Life', about some of the difficulties of her job, and why she fears for the future: So, and this person is quite already aggravated, and he keeps on yelling and that's the, you know, that's the difficult part because the mental stress also… you know, you have to pacify the client, and you have to make sure you're able to resolve the concern.
client.zh: 在这里，她向BBC世界服务部的节目“Tech Life”讲述了她工作中的一些困难，以及她为什么对未来感到恐惧：所以，这个人已经相当恼火了，他一直在大喊大叫，你知道的，这就是困难的部分，因为心理压力也……你知道的，你必须安抚客户，你必须确保你能解决他们的问题。

clay.en: Liquid clay technology is still new, and costing around 2,000 dollars an acre, it’s not cheap.
clay.zh: 液态粘土技术仍然很新，每英亩成本约为2000美元，并不便宜。

clay.en: Hmm, I think clay can be used to smooth the skin on people’s faces.
clay.zh: 嗯，我想粘土可以用来让人脸上的皮肤变得光滑。

clay.en: Cuneiform symbols were pressed into soft clay tablets using a stylus, like a stick.
clay.zh: 楔形文字符号是用触笔（类似于小棍子）压印在软泥板上的。

clay.en: Sumerians used clay tablets. Ancient Egyptians used scrolls made from papyrus.
clay.zh: 苏美尔人使用泥板。古埃及人使用由纸莎草制成的卷轴。

clay.en: In Cuneiform, symbols are pressed into clay tablets with a stylus.
clay.zh: 在楔形文字中，符号是用笔尖压印在泥板上的。

cluster.en: The labels above the switches ranged from "Slight Shock" through to "Moderate Shock," "Strong Shock," "Very Strong Shock," "Intense Shock," and "Extreme Intensity Shock," to a final cluster of three switches simply labelled "XXX."
cluster.zh: 开关上方的标签从“轻微电击”(Slight Shock)一路排到“中度电击”“强烈电击”“非常强烈电击”“剧烈电击”“极端强度电击”，最后三个开关干脆只标着“XXX”。

clarify.en: Now, Milgram was at pains to clarify what his findings did not mean.
clarify.zh: 不过，米尔格拉姆也一再费心澄清，他的研究结论并不意味着什么。

clarify.en: Perhaps he should have clarified that there was one man for whom this rule didn’t apply: him.
clarify.zh: 也许他本该澄清，有一个人是这个规则不适用的：那就是他自己。

clarify.en: Let’s start by clarifying the difference between ability and performance.
clarify.zh: 让我们首先厘清“能力（ability）”与“表现（performance）”的区别。

clarify.en: But a good question creates value. It clarifies something.
clarify.zh: 但一个好的问题能创造价值。它能澄清某些事情。

clarify.en: Some groups are likely to qualify faster, but as of the time I’m writing this, the government has not clarified.
clarify.zh: 某些群体可能会更快符合条件，但截至我写下这些内容时，政府尚未明确说明。

clown.en: There is the policeman. There is a clown called Joey.
clown.zh: 有警察。有一个名叫 Joey 的小丑。

classical.en: These were subjects drawn from the classical world, inspired by the rediscovery of Greek and Roman texts.
classical.zh: 这些学科取材于古典世界，受到对希腊和罗马文本重新发现的启发。

classical.en: And in the middle, you had rediscovered texts of Roman law and classical philosophy providing the material to study.
classical.zh: 而在中间，你拥有被重新发现的罗马法和古典哲学文本，为研究提供了材料。

classical.en: The ancient Egyptians, classical Greece, the Roman Empire, medieval Europe: all of it ran on burning wood and charcoal.
classical.zh: 古埃及人、古典希腊、罗马帝国、中世纪欧洲：所有这一切都是靠燃烧木头和木炭运转的。

clearing.en: You probably can guess this from my previous section, clearing up the institutions and the common misconceptions.
clearing.zh: 你大概从我之前理顺各大机构和常见误区的那一部分就能猜到这一点。

clearing.en: It wasn’t until 1957 that Massachusetts said sorry and tried to fix it again, clearing more names.
clearing.zh: 直到1957年，马萨诸塞州才正式道歉并试图再次纠正错误，为更多的人平反。

clearing.en: So, to wrap things up, Wyatt Earp died in 1929 without ever clearing his name, without ever seeing his book published, without ever appearing on a cinema screen.
clearing.zh: 所以，总结一下：Wyatt Earp 于1929年去世时，始终没能洗清自己的名声，没能看到自己的书出版，也没能在电影银幕上露面。

clearing.en: Britain is debating whether to give that up, and, in so doing, is asking whether eight centuries of constitutional principle are really worth sacrificing for the sake of clearing an administrative backlog.
clearing.zh: 英国正在争论是否要放弃这一点，而在这场争论中，它其实也是在追问：为了清理行政积压，牺牲掉八个世纪的宪制原则，真的值得吗？

clearing.en: The class worked tirelessly, collating records and writing letters, and in 2022, a bill was passed that officially exonerated Elizabeth Johnson Jr., thereby clearing the last convicted person in the Salem Witch Trials.
clearing.zh: 全班同学不知疲倦地工作，整理档案，写信求助，终于在2022年，一项法案通过了，正式宣布小伊丽莎白·约翰逊无罪，从而洗清了塞勒姆审巫案中最后一位被定罪者的罪名。

classify.en: They shouldn’t disclose any classified information, and simple bullet points were fine.
classify.zh: 他们不应泄露任何机密信息，简单的要点即可。

classify.en: Turing’s work at Bletchley Park was classified under the British Official Secrets Act until the 1990s.
classify.zh: Turing 在 Bletchley Park 的工作根据英国《官方保密法》被列为绝密，直到 20世纪90年代才解密。

classify.en: So, by this point, at the turn of the 20th century, there were something like 200 universities worldwide, depending on exactly what you classify as a university.
classify.zh: 所以，到了这个时候，即 20 世纪之交，全球大约有 200 所大学，这取决于你究竟如何将大学分类。

classify.en: He has leaked classified documents to a Labour Member of Parliament — documents that revealed the Argentine Navy ship General Belgrano had been sailing away from the British exclusion zone when it was sunk during the Falklands War, killing 323 Argentine sailors.
classify.zh: 他向一位工党下议院议员泄露了机密文件——这些文件揭示出，阿根廷海军的"贝尔格拉诺将军号"(General Belgrano)在福克兰战争中被击沉时，其实正驶离英国划定的禁区，这次击沉事件造成323名阿根廷海员丧生。

cliff.en: Petra is famous for its buildings carved directly into pink and red sandstone cliffs.
cliff.zh: 佩特拉以其直接雕刻在粉红色和红色砂岩悬崖上的建筑而闻名。

cliff.en: In his grief, the king jumped off a cliff into the sea.
cliff.zh: 在悲痛中，国王跳崖殉海。

cliff.en: And on the island, he also saw what fate awaited anyone who crossed the sadistic emperor: being pushed off a high cliff if they were lucky, and being slowly tortured to death if they weren’t.
cliff.zh: 在这个岛上，他也看到了任何敢于顶撞这位残暴皇帝的人将面临的命运：幸运的话被推下高高的悬崖，不幸的话则被慢慢折磨致死。

closet.en: Others were put into solitary confinement —a tiny, dark closet that could barely fit one person.
closet.zh: 还有的人被关进单人禁闭室——一个几乎只能容下一个人的狭小黑暗小隔间。

clash.en: I actually have a great example of when different time cultures clash.
clash.zh: 我其实有一个很好的例子，关于不同的时间文化是如何发生冲突的。

clash.en: There were violent clashes between the radical left and right wing groups and repeated challenges to democracy.
clash.zh: 激进的左翼和右翼集团之间发生了暴力冲突，对民主的挑战也不断出现。

clutch.en: Parts of cars like the “clutch”, “accelerators”,” indicators” and “mirrors”.
clutch.zh: 汽车零件，比如“离合器”、“油门”、“转向灯”和“后视镜”。
